 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Sunil Kumar Panwar
Oral Order
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
2. The petitioner has prayed for regular bail in a case instituted for the offence under Sections 420 and 414 of the IPC and Sections 30(a), 41(i)(ii) of the Bihar Prohibition and Excise Act.
3. As per prosecution case, there has been recovery of 2808 liters of illegal IMFL from a truck.
4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that petitioner has been falsely implicated in this case.
He has committed no offence.
Petitioner has not been apprehended on spot.
He submitted that the petitioner has no concern either with the seized vehicle or with the wine in question.
No incriminating article has been recovered from the conscious Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.81615 of 2023(2) dt.18-12-2023 possession of the petitioner.
Only on the basis of suspicion and due to his criminal antecedents, the petitioner has been made accused in the present case.

He is languishing in judicial custody since 03.10.2023.
5.
The application for bail is opposed by learned APP for the State.
